rule: Never edit these values in place. A change is a new version (new file content with a bumped version and a CHANGELOG line in SCORER-RESULTS.md); results are always reported with the version they used.
formula: score = exp( sum_i w_i ln max(c_i, floor) / sum_i w_i ); P = min(body term, min(1,p_fin_pectoral/alpha), p_fin_envelope_v11, organ_fit, p_state); body term = min(1, p_body_v11/alpha) for non-larval designs, p_larval_envelope for larval designs
changes_from_1.0.0: body block: a reference missing a feature the design has adds z^2 = 1 per missing feature (RMS over the design feature count) instead of being matched on the shared subset; minShared 3; calibration recomputed the same way

larval designs (stage embryo/hatching/larva): body block is an envelope over larval ontogeny-stage references (excluded lineages removed), widened x/1.5, p = exp(-excess/0.05 decades), used directly (no alpha)

fin envelope: excess in units of 0.05 log10 (was the cross-reference scale, ~0.3); pectoral length upper bound extended to the 0.823 flying-fish specimen maximum (Daane 2021 n 49, design-validation/REPORT.md)

P gains p_state: every bounded STATE field (gill area per kg, Hb P50, body density, red muscle fraction, routine metabolic rate, vertebra and ray counts, head fraction, section exponent, flight-muscle fraction) against sourced envelopes (sanity.mjs STATE_ENVELOPES), p = exp(-max excess/0.05 decades)
weights, floor, alpha, cut and evidence map unchanged
